in_sanskrit.name: देवराज
in_sanskrit.meaning: Lord of Debas or Lord of the senses
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who rules over the inner senses or passions. In Hindu mythology, Debas refer to the inner senses or passions, and Debaraj is considered to be the lord or controller of these inner senses.

in_hindi.name: देवराज
in_hindi.long_meaning: Devaraj is a compound word in Hindi. 'Dev' means god or divine, and 'Raj' means king or ruler. So, Devaraj means 'God-King' or 'Divine Ruler'.

in_tamil.name: தேவராஜ்
in_tamil.long_meaning: Thevaraj is a compound word in Tamil. 'Thevam' means god or divine, and 'Raj' means king or ruler. So, Thevaraj means 'God-King' or 'Divine Ruler'.

in_telugu.name: దేవరాజ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: Devaraj is a compound word in Telugu. 'Devamu' means god or divine, and 'Raju' means king or ruler. So, Devaraj means 'God-King' or 'Divine Ruler'.

in_marathi.name: Debaraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Debaraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name 'Debaraj' is derived from Sanskrit roots 'Deba' meaning 'God' and 'Raj' meaning 'King' or 'Servant'. In Hindu mythology, Debaraj refers to a God or a divine being who serves as a ruler or protector. The name signifies devotion and dedication to serving a higher power.
